name: echo
description: Run and Audit support for the Echo programming language.

echo.executable.markdownDescription: The command used to invoke the Echo CLI. Supports `${workspaceFolder}`. Defaults to auto-detecting `bin/dist/index.mjs` in the workspace, falling back to `lang` on your PATH.

echo.arch.description: Target architecture passed to the compiler via --arch.

echo.auditRuntime.markdownDescription: Path to `audit_runtime.c`, linked in when running Audit. Supports `${workspaceFolder}`. Defaults to `${workspaceFolder}/src/audit_runtime.c`.

enumDescriptions: Reuse a single Echo terminal across runs.
Create a fresh terminal for each run.
echo.terminal.description: How to manage the terminal used for runs.

enumDescriptions: Show parse and compile errors as you type (debounced).
Show errors only when a file is saved.
echo.diagnostics.description: When to compute Echo error diagnostics.
